statement: (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsReduced R] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι R) (h : IsNilpotent A) : A.charpoly = Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card ι
closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsReduced R] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι R) (h : IsNilpotent A), A.charpoly = Polynomial.X ^ Fintype.card ι
informal: The characteristic polynomial of a nilpotent square matrix over a reduced commutative ring is X^n (n = size). Promoted from the inline first step of Mathlib2.gen_lin_nilpotent_pow_card_reduced (also re-derived in gen_lin_nilpotent_det_one_add_reduced).
